name: ecommerce
title: E-commerce product organisation
source:
teamTopology
  title E-commerce product organisation
  flow Flow of change
  legend

  %% Stream-aligned teams own a slice of the product end to end
  stream   checkout   "Checkout"            [size=7]
  stream   search     "Search & Discovery"  [size=6]
  stream   accounts   "Accounts & Identity" [size=5]

  %% Enabling teams lift the capability of stream teams, then move on
  enabling devex      "Developer Experience"

  %% Complicated subsystems need deep specialist knowledge
  subsystem ranking   "Ranking Engine" [note="ML relevance model"]

  %% Platforms reduce cognitive load for the teams above
  platform  infra     "Infrastructure Platform" [note="Kubernetes, CI, observability"]
  platform  payments  "Payments Platform"

  %% Interactions
  infra    --> checkout, search, accounts : Kubernetes & CI [duration=ongoing]
  payments --> checkout                   : Payments API
  ranking  --> search                     : Ranking API
  search   <--> ranking                   : new signals
  devex    ~~> checkout, accounts         : CI pipelines [duration="until Q3"]

  %% Expected soon: drawn dashed, listed under "teams we expect to interact with soon"
  search <--> accounts : personalised results [soon, duration="8 weeks"]

  %% Team API fields the diagram cannot infer (see the Team API panel / --api)
  api checkout {
    focus: the checkout experience end to end
    software: checkout-service, cart-ui
    SLE: 99.9% availability, p95 < 300 ms
    versioning: semver, two releases of deprecation notice
    wiki: checkout, cart, basket
    chat: #checkout #checkout-alerts
    sync: 09:30 UTC
    working on: migrating to the new payments API
    ways of working: trunk-based development, pairing on Tuesdays
    improvements: shared on-call rotation with Accounts
  }

name: org-groups
title: Product organisation
source:
teamTopology
  title Product organisation

  group customer "Customer Group" {
    stream accounts "Accounts"
    stream business "Business"
    stream success  "Customer Success"
    stream billing  "Billing"
    subsystem data1 "Data"
    subsystem sec1  "Security"
    enabling ux1    "UX Research"
    platform frontend "Frontend Platform"

    data1 --> accounts
    sec1  --> accounts
    frontend --> accounts, billing
    ux1 ~~> accounts, business, success, billing
  }

  group content "Content Group" {
    stream runtime   "Runtime"
    stream registry  "Registry"
    stream build     "Build"
    stream consumer  "Content Consumer"
    stream publisher "Content Publisher"
    subsystem data2  "Data"
    enabling ux2     "UX Research"

    data2 --> publisher
    ux2 ~~> runtime, registry, build, consumer, publisher
  }

  group devexp "Developer Experience Group" {
    stream pos   "Programmable OS"
    stream inner "Inner Loop"
    subsystem data3 "Data"
    enabling ux3    "UX Research"
    platform desktop "Desktop Platform"

    data3 --> inner
    desktop --> pos
    ux3 ~~> pos, inner
  }

  platform cloud "Cloud Group" {
    platform saas  "SaaS Platform"
    platform infra "Infrastructure"
    subsystem sec2 "Security"
    subsystem data4 "Data"
    infra --> saas
  }

  ux1 <--> content
  ux2 <--> devexp
  saas --> frontend, desktop
  saas --> content

name: platform-grouping
title: Platform grouping
source:
teamTopology
  title Platform grouping
  flow

  stream mobile "Mobile App"
  stream web    "Web Storefront"
  enabling sre  "SRE Coaching"

  %% A platform can itself be a topology of teams
  platform cloud "Cloud Platform" {
    stream    k8s   "Kubernetes"
    stream    obs   "Observability"
    subsystem net   "Network Fabric"
    platform  bare  "Bare-metal Fleet"

    bare --> k8s, obs
    net  --> k8s : overlay networking
  }

  k8s --> mobile, web       : runtime
  obs --> mobile, web       : dashboards & alerts
  sre ~~> web               : incident reviews
  mobile <--> web           : shared design system

name: value-streams
title: Two value streams sharing one platform
source:
teamTopology
  title Two value streams sharing one platform
  flow

  group retail "Retail" [kind="value stream"] {
    stream storefront "Storefront"
    stream fulfilment "Fulfilment"
    storefront <--> fulfilment : order events
  }

  group b2b "Business" [kind="value stream"] {
    stream catalog "Catalog"
    stream invoicing "Invoicing"
  }

  enabling  security "Security Enablement"
  subsystem tax      "Tax Calculation"
  platform  core     "Core Platform" [note="identity, billing, data"]

  core --> storefront, fulfilment, catalog, invoicing
  tax  --> invoicing, storefront : tax rules API
  security ~~> catalog, storefront : threat modelling
